basics.name: William Kirschenman
basics.label: PhD Candidate in Operations Research
basics.summary: PhD Candidate in Operations Research at NC State University and U.S. Army Operations Research Analyst. Research focuses on 2-D orthogonal packing optimization for military logistics applications.

work.name: The Research and Analysis Center (TRAC), Army Futures Command
work.summary: Led development of TRAC's Visualization Application with Data collection in R (VADR), a cloud-based planning and analytical tool for wargaming. Led planning, execution and analysis for AFC's 2020 Capstone Wargame focused on EUCOM.

work.name: 2nd Infantry Brigade Combat Team, 4th Infantry Division
work.position: Company Commander / Brigade Engineer Plans Officer
work.summary: Commanded two Engineer companies of over 100 Soldiers each. Served as primary engineer planner for a 3,500-Soldier Brigade Combat Team.

awards.title: Salah E. Elmaghraby Distinguished Student Award
awards.awarder: Operations Research Program, NC State University
awards.summary: Awarded for outstanding doctoral research in operations research.

awards.title: General Omar N. Bradley Research Fellowship in Mathematics
awards.summary: Fellowship supporting doctoral research in mathematical sciences. Renewed for 2025.

awards.title: Best Presentation - Wargaming Working Group
awards.summary: Awarded for presentation on distributed wargaming visualization and data collection.

awards.title: Outstanding Academic Achievement Award in Operations Research
awards.summary: Awarded for exceptional academic performance in the M.S. Operations Research program.

publications.name: Enhancing Military Load Planning: A Prioritized 2-D Orthogonal Packing Approach
publications.summary: Develops enhanced methods for military load planning using prioritized 2-D orthogonal packing approaches.

publications.name: The 2-D Orthogonal Packing Problem with Multiple Levels of Prioritization
publications.summary: Develops a multi-level prioritization framework for the 2-D packing problem with military logistics applications.

publications.name: Automated Vessel Selection and Combat Load Planning
publications.summary: Presents computational frameworks for optimizing cargo allocation and vessel utilization in combat scenarios.

projects.name: Prioritized 2-D Orthogonal Packing
projects.summary: Dissertation research developing novel approaches for military combat loading optimization with multi-level priority constraints.

projects.name: VADR - Visualization Application with Data collection in R
projects.summary: Cloud-based planning and analytical tool for wargaming and data collection events developed for Army Futures Command.
